title: A collaborator without a Frequency account can vote on dates from the email link

source.ref: Hub plan 2026-11-24 (project thread: Design a central project and messaging hub; owner ask 2026-11-24 17:35Z: AI meeting and date management so everyone can brainstorm the best date and time)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-24: owner ruling 2026-11-24 makes email the only outside channel for now, so outside collaborators (a venue, a guest teacher) must be able to pick a date from their inbox. Fix: a signed, expiring vote link per person per Plan (signTimeVoteToken/verifyTimeVoteToken) opening a one-page vote with no sign-in; the vote records the email address against the Plan.

verify.note: Fails today; passes once the consequence in the title holds.
